## A full redesign, and a server-wide spotlight

This is the big one. The whole menu has been rebuilt from the ground up, and the server gets its own personality: a live "Trending this week" spotlight that surfaces whatever everyone is playing right now.

### Redesign

Both layouts got a complete visual overhaul, rebuilt around one consistent design language — category-tinted icons, a clean elevation ladder, flat tabs with an accent underline, calmer spacing.

**Cinematic** is now an edge-docked, full-height panel that blends into the scene through a soft vignette.

![Cinematic layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_emote_menu/dc23a6f/.github/release-assets/v1.4.0-cinematic.png)

**Default** is a bounded, draggable floating panel — a solid object you can place wherever you like.

![Default layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_emote_menu/dc23a6f/.github/release-assets/v1.4.0-standard.png)

Every emote card, the category rail, the tabs, the search field, the playlist and quick-bind panels were rebuilt to match.

### Features

- **Trending this week** — the browse view now opens with a hero spotlight showing the single most-played emote across the whole server, on a rolling 7-day window. Purely aggregate — the server counts plays, never *who* played what. One click plays it.

### Improvements

- **Emote wheel** is more compact and less intrusive on screen while you hold the wheel key
- **Random emote** moved into the result bar, next to Sort & filter — one click away
- **Cleaner cards** — play counts and badges line up in a tidy column; action buttons reveal on hover without nudging anything
- **Consistent theming** — change the accent colour in the config and the whole UI re-tints with it: menu, emote wheel and on-screen pills alike

### Bug fixes

- The nearby-player search is now distance-capped — a modified UI could previously request an oversized radius
- Opening a card's drawer no longer knocks the emote list's scroll position out of sync

### Refactor

- On-screen pills and bubbles were re-architected to update on their own, so ambient activity never re-renders the menu in the background
- The "What's That Emote?" tracker no longer runs every frame when there is nothing nearby to track
- A dead-code sweep across styles, scripts and locale files — leaner build
- All six languages re-synced, so the redesigned interface is fully translated everywhere

### Install

Download `mbt_emote_menu.zip` below and drop it in your resources folder. Existing installs upgrade in place — favourites, recent list, wheel slots and custom lists are kept.

If you previously bound the Emote Wheel hotkey, double-check **FiveM Settings → Key Bindings → MBT Emote Wheel (Hold)** after the update — FiveM caches keymappings per-resource and the binding may need re-confirming.

Requires [rpemotes-reborn](https://github.com/alberttheprince/rpemotes-reborn) latest.
